en-US.name: Christ Schools Menu
en-US.summary: Hear Christ Schools lunch for today, a date, next week, or next Tuesday from the official calendar.
en-US.description:
Christ Schools Menu reads the official Christ Schools elementary lunch calendar so you can ask Alexa what's for lunch without opening a browser.

WHAT YOU CAN ASK
• Today or tomorrow: "Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch today"
• A specific date: "Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch on August seventeenth"
• A weekday: "Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch on Friday"
• Next week (Monday–Friday): "Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch next week"
• Relative days: "Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch next Tuesday" or "this coming Wednesday"

HOW IT WORKS
The skill loads the public Christ Schools lunch Google Calendar each time you ask. No account or student information is required. If school is out or no menu is posted for a day, Alexa will say there is no lunch information for that day.

VOICE COMMANDS
Say "help" for examples, "repeat" to hear the last answer again, or "stop" to exit.

Full user guide: https://github.com/andystumpf/christ-schools-lunch-menu/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch today
Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu show me the menu for next week
Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu show me the menu for this week

publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
Enable the skill in Development and test with Skill I/O, Manual JSON, or an Echo Show with development access enabled.

Single day:
Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch today
Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch on August seventeenth

Week view:
Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu what's for lunch next week
Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu show me the menu for this week

Echo Show (APL): responses should display a deep navy screen with per-day cards (gold accent bar, white menu bullets, scrollable week view). Single-day menus with OR choices show each option on its own row. Round Echo devices show a centered simplified layout.

Expected: spoken menu from the public Christ Schools Google Calendar. Days with no calendar entry should say no lunch information is available.

Help: Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu help
Stop: Alexa, ask Christ Schools Menu stop
